product_one_liner.value: Sona is an AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations that matches staffing to demand and reduces managers’ administrative work.
product_one_liner.notes: Sona’s own job description describes its AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations and agents that match staffing to demand and reduce managers’ administration: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/sona/68c05d9d-2fdf-4193-a8d9-2f02d4100637.

pricing_page.notes: Sona has a public page specifically discussing configurable pricing, although it does not publish numeric prices: https://www.getsona.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both organisations have official Sona case studies describing their use of the platform. Sources: https://www.getsona.com/case-studies/paul-uk and https://getsona.com/case-studies/greensleeves-care. | named_customers.0: An official customer case study describes PAUL UK using Sona: https://www.getsona.com/case-studies/paul-uk. | named_customers.1: The official case study states that Greensleeves Care partnered with Sona: https://getsona.com/case-studies/greensleeves-care.

employee_band.notes: The matching Sona company profile lists 255 employees, placing it in 201-500. Other directories give differing estimates, so confidence is medium. Source: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/632cbc0758dc67491f811fea/sona?utm_source=parallel&utm_medium=ai#a:about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Sona’s funding press release explicitly states that it is headquartered in London: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sona-raises-45m-series-b-to-bring-ai-to-the-frontline-economy-302730478.html. | hq_country: The headquarters listing identifies London, England, GB, while the matching company profile specifies United Kingdom. Source: https://enrichlayer.com/company/getsona.

founded_year.notes: Sona’s official About page explicitly states that it was founded in 2021: https://www.getsona.com/about.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog indexes show industry advice, partnerships, customer news and product announcements, rather than the required two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built. Sources: https://www.sona.ai/blog and https://getsona.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: Sona’s public help center contains multiple product-support articles, including downloading the app, messaging a manager and understanding shift colours: https://getsona.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb/sections/7065836833565-Using-Sona.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Sona’s live Senior Machine Learning Engineer posting includes an application link and directly meets the qualifying-title rule: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Sona/b0ecc744-e4ac-441e-9f19-dbd961847836.

model_provider.notes: Sona’s official subprocessor list names both OpenAI and Anthropic as LLM providers: https://www.sona.ai/sub-processors.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Sona’s Trust Center explicitly claims ISO 27001:2022 certification and names GDPR. GDPR is reported as a public compliance claim, not as an independently issued certification: https://trust.sona.ai/. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly states that Sona is ISO 27001:2022 certified: https://trust.sona.ai/. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names GDPR among Sona’s public compliance claims: https://trust.sona.ai/.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The official announcement names the round as Series B, and the funding profile identifies it as Sona’s latest round. Sources: https://www.sona.ai/blog/sona-raises-45m-series-b-to-bring-ai-to-the-frontline-economy and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/sona-2/financials. | funding_date: The official Series B announcement is dated April 1, 2026; the funding profile also identifies this as the latest round. Normalised to YYYY-MM, the date is 2026-04. Sources: https://www.sona.ai/blog/sona-raises-45m-series-b-to-bring-ai-to-the-frontline-economy and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/sona-2/financials. | funding_amount_usd: Sona’s official announcement reports $45 million, and its funding profile identifies that Series B as the latest round. Sources: https://www.sona.ai/blog/sona-raises-45m-series-b-to-bring-ai-to-the-frontline-economy and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/sona-2/financials.

raised_18mo.notes: Sona announced its $45 million Series B on April 1, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026: https://www.sona.ai/blog/sona-raises-45m-series-b-to-bring-ai-to-the-frontline-economy.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sona postings include both Account Executive and Business Development Representative roles with application links. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/sona/68c05d9d-2fdf-4193-a8d9-2f02d4100637 and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/sona/8ed590ab-ec44-4529-92e8-44f40c918fcf.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 22, 2026 announcement says Sona LMS is now available and describes substantive learning-management and shift-eligibility functionality. This falls within the six months before November 9, 2026: https://www.sona.ai/blog/why-we-launched-sona-lms.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jennifer Johnson’s profile lists VP, Solution Marketing at Sona with a start date of September 1, 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Her announcement also says she is starting that role and links to Sona’s getsona company page. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/jenniferklahrejohnson and https://linkedin.com/in/Jenniferklahrejohnson.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Sona revenue-operations posting describes administering its GTM data model across HubSpot, while its official subprocessor list names Planhat as a CRM. Sources: https://careers.antler.co/companies/sona-2/jobs/79459664-revenue-operations-manager and https://www.sona.ai/sub-processors. | crm_stack_signal.0: The revenue-operations posting explicitly describes Sona’s GTM data model across HubSpot: https://careers.antler.co/companies/sona-2/jobs/79459664-revenue-operations-manager. | crm_stack_signal.1: Sona’s official subprocessor list names Planhat and labels its purpose CRM: https://www.sona.ai/sub-processors.
